name: Tech Race
description: A deep-pocketed rival is sprinting toward the electronics future. Out-research them: stand up multiple R&D centres, put both televisions and cars on your shelves, and win a plurality of the Metropolis TV market — all while keeping the lights on.

goals.description: Operate at least 2 R&D Centres — research compounds with labs.
Put televisions on a shelf — a tech-tier product with a meaningful supply chain (electronic_parts + plastic + steel).
Put cars on a shelf — the flagship automotive product, priced at a premium.
Run an ongoing ad campaign for television — brand awareness compounds over time.
Reach 35% share of television in Metropolis — your tech lead should show up on the softmax allocator.
Keep the company alive and growing: reach $40M corporate value.
